seed: A recording opened the way the Finder opens one, at Next defaults with no flag set and nothing remembered, opens to watch: nothing picked, the arrow in hand, the timeline tucked down to the transport and one row. Space plays it. The row brings the tracks up; putting them away is remembered for the next recording; and an edit key (I) brings them up by itself. It used to open with the clip picked and Trim in hand, which the user turned down on 2026-09-25.

steps.note: THE TEST: just opened, nothing pressed. The picture over the transport, one TIMELINE row under it, no clip picked, no Trim
space played it and space stopped it, and the timeline stayed tucked away while it did
the row under the transport opened the tracks: ruler, V1, the timeline's own bar
tucked away again, then I marked an In, and the tracks came up by themselves to show it
the last choice made by hand was to put the tracks away, and an edit bringing them up is not a choice, so the same recording opened again comes up tucked away
opened the tracks by hand, then opened the recording again: it comes up with them showing, still with nothing picked and the arrow in hand
